title: A synthesized talking head plays a falling-block game by voice
summary: On Fri 13 Nov at 05:01Z @yonderdavid.bsky.social (971 followers) posted a video with no text. Its alt text reads: "A chimera-vocal-synth talking head plays a falling block game using voice commands." The post quotes a 9 Nov post by @norvid-studies.bsky.social, "catoid week rolls smoothly into chimera vocal synth week". It has 78 likes and 9 reposts. In replies the maker said the synth builds to wasm, the frames were generated in a browser, the audio tracks were generated separately and mixed, and ffmpeg assembled the video; later the same day, answering a question about a different video, the maker added that this one "featured a chiptune arrangement of Ievan Polkka". A reply from @shimmermathlabs.com lists five commands, one per line. The synth is chimera-vocal-synth, an open-source vocal synthesizer whose GitHub repository (jamesondh/chimera-vocal-synth) the maker links; the bible says the show's own voices are synthesized by CHIMERA, a physical-model vocal synth.
